answer: Orchard Depth Escrow: each identity must deposit a rising amount drawn from a public cost curve indexed to its signup rank. Early joiners pay little; the violet band of late arrivals pays steeply, and activity unlocks only as stake seasons. Reaching the top zenith tier requires years of holding. Sybil farms face superlinear cost per head, so N fakes cost roughly N^2, making mass identity capture unprofitable.
